title: 8 Rooms Where a Godly Man's Humility Actually Gets Tested
caption:
8 rooms where a godly man's humility actually gets tested. Not one of them is the pew.

The comment section under his own post. The negotiation where he could push for more. The car, alone, right after the compliment. The meeting where his idea gets passed over and he still means it when he says good call. The text from the guy who annoys him, answered the same day he'd answer his best friend.

The interview where he could stretch the truth about himself. The prayer nobody's grading. The line he could cut and nobody would stop him.

Humility isn't tested where people are watching. It's built where they're not.
